sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 1997
ORDINANCE II OF 1997
PAKISTAN STANDARDS AND QUALITY
CONTROL AUTHORITY AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1997
An Ordinance to amend of Pakistan
Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd January, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 2‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend the
Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 (VI of 1996), for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is‑satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Pakistan. standards and Quality Control Authority (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Whereas it is expedient to amend the

And whereas the National Assembly is
